title: monday.com pricing - $9-$19 per seat/month annual, 3-seat minimum on all paid plans
clean_text: monday.com offers a limited free plan for up to 2 seats, then three paid per-seat tiers billed annually: Basic at $9/seat/month, Standard at $12/seat/month, and Pro at $19/seat/month (monthly billing raises these to $12, $14, and $24 respectively). All paid plans require a minimum of 3 seats, so the effective monthly minimum is $27 (Basic), $36 (Standard), or $57 (Pro). Enterprise pricing is custom. Volume discounts typically apply at 50, 100, and 200+ seat thresholds.
